status: design proposal; scaling and thaw decisions open
directions_and_recommendations: Approved: Bless and Curse are stacking buff/debuff counters affecting every hit of the next direct attack. Mark and Weaken are removed from current effects and rules. Applications add, non-attacks preserve counters, and the next attack spends all of both even if damage is zero.

Recommendation: flat +1/−1 per stack, with minimum final damage 0 and no extra counter or damage cap. Current mana, cards and one-attack consumption bound individual uses; that is not proof of balance. Stack counts were conservatively retuned to mostly 1–2, with 3 on a few Banish sources. These are provisional counts, not a conversion formula to preserve old balance.
The numerical decision is OPEN. Current catalogue previews explicitly use the flat candidate as a working proposal. No percentage rate, rounding mode or percentage cap is approved.

Comparison candidate only: each stack adds or subtracts 25 percentage points. Combine Bless minus Curse, clamp the multiplier between 0× and 2×, then round each final hit to nearest integer with half ties upward. Do not compound multipliers. This permits meaningful comparison without selecting it as the rule.

Low hit sizes make percentage steps uneven. Nearest rounding leaves 2-damage hits unchanged under Curse 1; the Millipede gets the same 6 total under Curse 1 and Curse 2. Rounding down instead can erase 1-damage hits with one stack while making small Bless bonuses invisible. Rounding up reverses that bias. Fractional carry or attack-total redistribution could fix some thresholds but adds hidden arithmetic and order rules.

Flat scaling deliberately rewards or counters many-hit attacks. Bless 1 adds 3 total to Prism but 1 to a single hit; Curse 1 removes 5 total from the Millipede when it has five positive hits. Test these interactions with Leech, reflection, Banish thinning and repeated draw/recovery.

Curse can reduce direct hits to 0, but separate Burn, Poison, card movement, healing and trait clauses still happen. Freeze controls the entire action; Hush suppresses the labeled trait and skips non-attack abilities. Those remain distinct even when Curse prevents all direct damage.

Freeze control is approved. Its thaw rule is OPEN: whether direct attacks and/or Fire end it is not defined. Preview only the conditional case “if still Frozen at action start, skip the whole action, advance and clear”. Do not treat earlier breakable-freeze proposals, or a no-thaw alternative, as a settled rule.

Cleanse and Purge explicitly remove one random eligible kind or all eligible kinds. Random is uniform by active kind, not stack amount; clear the whole chosen counter. No target menu. Typed narrow cures and partial Ward removal remain separate when those better fit the subject.

The main player decisions are which cards to play and in what order. Enemy held-card moves now choose random recipients; helpful recovery uses the top discarded card. The remaining older card-selection effects below are flagged for a future thematic redesign rather than silently converted into risky random Banish or recovery effects.

Ward.player_timing: before player mana refill and normal draw
Ward.enemy_timing: enemy action start, after all damage-over-time ticks, including skipped actions

damage_over_time.timing: player turn end, after unkept cards are discarded
damage_over_time.application: maximum of existing and incoming value, separately per status

Scry.scope: current top of library, follows changes

Keep.source: return marked source after resolution, within hand cap
Keep.marker_loss: leaving hand or after end-turn discard

Flip.self: resolving physical source; finish original played description
Flip.top_of_pile: visible named top card, no choice
Flip.random: automatic, uniformly without replacement after payment

attack_modifiers.approved: Bless and Curse add stacks and affect every hit of the next direct attack; replace Mark and Weaken

flat_candidate.formula: max(0, base hit + first-hit weakness + Bless - Curse)

percentage_candidate.stacking: add percentage points; net Bless minus Curse before clamping

attack_modifiers.duration: next direct attack, including its extra hits; non-attacks do not spend counters
attack_modifiers.stacking: add; consume all Bless and Curse on that attack, even at zero damage
attack_modifiers.damage_types: each hit keeps its printed type

Freeze.skip: whole next action if still active; advance pattern and clear
Freeze.preview: conditional on still Frozen at the scheduled action; no thaw rule assumed
Freeze.reactive_traits: remain active while displayed unless Hushed

Cleanse.quantity: one random eligible status or all, explicitly printed

Purge.quantity: one random eligible status or all, explicitly printed

unresolved_decisions: Bless/Curse flat versus percentage scaling and final per-card stack counts
Freeze thaw from attacks and/or Fire

limitations: Reference-model arithmetic and static consistency only; no complete combat simulation or human playtest.
Percentage parameters are comparison assumptions, not approval.
Freeze sequences with an intervening attack or Fire cannot receive a final outcome until thaw is chosen.
Older incidental card choices are flagged, not all redesigned.
